artBrief: **Pixel fine art.** A whimsical calendar-like mosaic with scattered star markers, a wandering ribbon, and a tiny paintbrush. No dates, numbers, or shame-coded red crosses.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Pixel fine art. A whimsical calendar-like mosaic with scattered star markers, a wandering ribbon, and a tiny paintbrush. No dates, numbers, or shame-coded red crosses. One central abstract calendar-like mosaic of blank pastel tiles, irregularly placed gold star markers, a wandering coral ribbon and small paintbrush. Playful painterly pixel clusters, no dates or numerals.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
